visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a dark suit jacket and a bright red bowtie sits at a desk in a bright room, staring intently at a silver laptop. The screen shows a video of another man outdoors. He adjusts his black glasses suspiciously as the camera zooms in on the laptop. (2) The scene shifts to a dark kitchen. The man in the suit uses the bright light emanating from his circular smartwatch to search through a dark upper cabinet filled with snack boxes and protein cereals. He looks at the watch face which shows a digital compass interface. (3) He opens a stainless steel refrigerator door, and the interior light illuminates his shocked expression as he sees a single cupcake with a pink 'Happy Birthday' sign inside. He then opens a white bedroom door to find another man lying in bed with a laptop, laughing. (4) In the living room, the man in the suit (now seen wearing shorts under his jacket) points accusingly at the other man sitting on a grey sofa eating from a large bag of snacks. He hands the other man a yellow and grey Garmin smartwatch. (5) Ian begins a montage of using the watch. A close-up shows the watch on a wooden table, then Ian's fingers scrolling through biometric data screens like heart rate and HRV. He wakes up in a bed with tan sheets, checking his sleep score on the watch face. (6) Ian is shown outdoors on a sunlit street with green trees, stretching his legs while wearing a white t-shirt and black athletic shorts. He checks his watch and begins jogging. A later shot shows him looking sweaty and satisfied after the workout. (7) Ian speaks directly to the camera in various settings: sitting on a bed at night and standing in a park. He demonstrates the watch's training menu. Finally, a white barcode with the text 'Garmin-DoDomen' appears over his face in a bright indoor setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with high-arousal, investigative electronic BGM featuring a sharp, driving beat. A male narrator speaks with a mock-serious, theatrical tone. A series of digital UI 'pings' and metallic clicks signify the use of a high-tech watch interface. (2) A sudden burst of high-pitched male laughter breaks the tension, followed by a hard cut to more upbeat, major-key pop music with a steady rhythmic pulse. The dialogue becomes conversational and friendly. (3) Ambient sound effects of a cabinet door opening and a refrigerator compressor hum are audible behind the clean studio vocals. (4) During the outdoor segment, subtle natural ambience (distant wind) is present, but masked by a swelling electronic soundtrack. Rapid-fire vocal delivery is synchronized with the upbeat tempo. (5) The final phase features a clear, bright call-to-action with high vocal valence and minimal background noise. The music remains consistent in its energetic pop feel until a clean fade-out at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the Garmin Instinct Crossover smartwatch by framing its health-tracking features as a solution to weight gain and poor lifestyle habits. It uses a humorous 'detective' skit to identify the problem before transitioning into a practical lifestyle demonstration of the product's benefits.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the product name, visual focus on product features, and a discount code/barcode at the end.
